notes.base_url: null = auto-resolve from APP_PORT (env var or repo .env). Set explicitly to override.
notes.coding_agent_command: CLI executable for auto-repair; the repair prompt is piped to its stdin. Swap for any agent CLI, e.g. 'codex' with coding_agent_args ['exec'] or claude with ['-p', '--dangerously-skip-permissions'] for full-permission unattended runs.
notes.coding_agent_args: Arguments passed before stdin. Default lets Claude Code edit files headlessly without shell access; the autopilot handles testing/rollback itself.
notes.auto_commit: Commit kept repairs (runtime logs/ are always excluded from autopilot commits).
notes.rollback_on_worse: git reset --hard to the pre-repair checkpoint when results get worse or do not improve.
notes.usage: Copy to agent/config.json to override; config.json wins over this example file.
